short_prompt:
Use $scene-layout-forge to create one PNG of this subject: A top-down orthographic layout of a technical control room and storage space. Preserve entrance and internal passage openings. Draw walls, furniture and meaningful English labels. No perspective, people, invented dimensions or implied building-code certification.
Use the skill's written detailed technical-anime style without reference images. Include a few meaningful English arrow callouts. First inspect/adapt the matching procedural example, validate geometry and view, then generate and inspect the actual artistic image. Preserve user scope; do not add factory equipment. Output only final.png in a new numbered folder under the current project's output directory; verify and clean owned intermediates. Report remaining uncertainty.

Before finishing, read references/art-direction.md and use its explicit handoff: subject-specific detail map, three line weights, neutral tone, hand-lettered English callouts and unambiguous arrow tips. Preserve any explicit view; otherwise choose freely without importing this example camera. Review style separately from counts, and use references/mechanical-coherence.md when motion or force is implied.

Apply references/context-composition.md: respect the explicit view and any isolated-study intent in this example; otherwise choose restrained context and a useful view. Treat example geometry/camera as adaptable patterns, not defaults for unrelated subjects. Plan meaningful variety without altering required counts or functional symmetry; inspect final context separately from detail.
intent: A top-down orthographic layout of a technical control room and storage space. Preserve entrance and internal passage openings. Draw walls, furniture and meaningful English labels. No perspective, people, invented dimensions or implied building-code certification.

relationships: existing typed interfaces or localized attachments

negative_controls: Incorrect inventory; floating worker, displaced route endpoint, detached attachment or shaft/bearing misalignment where the actual fixture defines them.
limits: No final-pixel observation is supplied by these geometry commands.
Coverage partial remains partial; a schema number or successful loader cannot promote it to complete strict coverage.
